snippet.title: Mario Kart World – Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026
snippet.description:
A free update for Mario Kart World launches later today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/mario-kart-world-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Play 10 classic courses from Super Mario Kart in VS Race mode. Barrel through Choco Island, Vanilla Lake, Ghost Valley and more!  Just like in the Super Mario Kart game, you can ride over ? Panels on these courses to get items.

Plus, two new routes are coming to Knockout Tour: Propeller Rally and Turnip Rally.

#NintendoDirect #MarioKartWorld

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
